"AETHERIA – CAREFUL GRAPHICS IMPROVEMENT

Continue working on the existing saved AETHERIA project. Do not create a new project.

I want to improve the graphics gradually and carefully. The current gameplay, world, characters, monsters, inventory, equipment, quests, combat, controls and save system must remain fully functional.

Visual goals:

- Change the game world to a more detailed and beautiful 2.5D isometric style.
- Zoom the camera out slightly so the player character appears smaller and more of the environment is visible.
- Make characters, monsters and NPCs slightly larger and more detailed than their current small appearance, while keeping balanced proportions.
- Improve the ground, grass, trees, rocks, buildings, water, lighting and environmental details.
- Improve character and monster sprites with consistent HD pixel-art details.
- Add smoother walking, attack and idle animations where possible.
- Make monsters visually distinct and recognizable.
- Keep the interface readable and suitable for mobile screens.

IMPORTANT – WORK IN SMALL STEPS:

1. First inspect the existing graphics, rendering system and source files.
2. Improve the camera and zoom first. Test the game.
3. Improve the player character and monster sprites next. Test again.
4. Improve the environment and map graphics afterward.
5. Improve animations and visual effects last.
6. After every step, check for errors before continuing.

Do not replace working systems unnecessarily. Do not rewrite the entire renderer. Do not remove existing content or change gameplay mechanics.

If a visual change causes errors, fix it before moving on. Save working changes frequently.

Final requirement: The game must still start, characters must move, monsters must be attackable, and all existing gameplay systems and saves must continue working.

Work carefully. Prioritize a stable, visible improvement over attempting too many changes at once. At the end, report exactly what visual changes were successfully implemented and tested.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
